title: Daily Signal Brief 016 — Mobley FEHA reach, Bersin HR 2030, SHRM Annual
summary: Three signals, top alert L3. Signal 01 (L3 Action): Judge Rita Lin (N.D. Cal.) heard oral argument 6/15 on her 5/27 tentative that California FEHA reaches Workday's AI hiring tools nationwide because Workday itself is an 'employment agency' under FEHA — if finalized, every AI hiring vendor including Stratum is directly reachable any time a California applicant is screened. Pairs with Friday's federal-preemption-narrows signal as floor + ceiling on AI hiring vendor compliance. Recommended: Compass + Forge integrate Mobley reading into the audit-trail comparison brief in flight; Helm + Forge draft an internal one-pager on contract-liability implications within 10 days; Vector sends a California-applicant talking-points note to Cordova, Halcyon, Mercator, and Northwind by Wednesday EOD. Signal 02 (L2 Watch): Josh Bersin Company released HR 2030: The Agentic HR Blueprint on 6/8 — predicts 30–50% HR headcount reduction by 2030, 95-capability map, 95-to-130 specialized agents architecture, and names 'agent sprawl' as the next compliance crisis. The Bersin frame is the analyst-side anchor for the SHRM Annual buyer mood Stratum will encounter through Q3. Recommended: Compass + Vector ship Stratum-voice answer to the headcount-cut question by Wednesday EOD; Kernel adds Bersin's 95-capability cross-reference at /eval/ within two weeks. Signal 03 (L2 Watch): SHRM Annual 2026 opened today in Orlando (6/16–6/19, 20,000+ attendees, 'Connected Intelligence' theme) with Workday-partnered agentic-AI sessions, BambooHR CEO Brad Rencher keynoting, Paylocity AI panels. Post-conference buyer expectations will be agentic-saturated through end-of-July. O-2 reflection: dispatch caught Mobley 6/15 same-day; missed Bersin 6/8 by 8 days and the 5/27 Mobley tentative by 18 days — adding state-court AI-employment-litigation watch and analyst-firm watch (Bersin, Aptitude, Forrester, Gartner) to the daily watch-list.
